description: This file defines a static class `CacheHelpers` containing utility methods for generating cache keys and a default cache duration within the Web project of eShopOnWeb. It provides methods to generate cache keys for catalog items, brands, and types, aiding in cache management strategies.

classes.name: CacheHelpers
classes.description: A static utility class for generating cache keys related to catalog items, brands, and types, as well as providing a default cache duration.

methods.name: GenerateCatalogItemCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key string for catalog items based on page index, items per page, and optional brand and type IDs.

methods.name: GenerateBrandsCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a static cache key string for brand-related cache entries.

methods.name: GenerateTypesCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a static cache key string for type-related cache entries.
